comment: check:api-shape's shrink-only baseline (scripts/check-api-shape.mjs). Each list is one finding per line — delete the line when it is fixed; `pnpm api-shape:update` drops fixed entries and lowers numbers but never adds. `exhaustiveByDesign` is a permanent allowlist (entry -> reason) for closed literal sets an author is meant to switch over exhaustively.

exhaustiveByDesign.agent: AgentMode — closed literal union: the discriminant of agent()'s parameter union: every agent is exactly one mode, and a new mode is a new member of that union, which is a break whatever this type says
exhaustiveByDesign.events: SessionEventMap.\"history.restor: a restored transcript holds only the two dialogue roles, and aai-ui's ChatMessage role set is this set: a third role would be a new kind of row the client must render
exhaustiveByDesign.protocol: RestoredToolCall.status — clos: a restored tool call is pending or done — the two states a settled join of tool.called/tool.completed can be in
exhaustiveByDesign.workflow-api: ClientConfigResponse.page: the two front doors a server can have (a voice page or a static workflow-app page); the client renders one or the other
exhaustiveByDesign.workflow-api: TerminalWorkflowRun.status: WorkflowRunSnapshot is a discriminated union read by switching on status to reach output/error; the engine's states are final (the client-side 'waiting' is ClientRunStatus's spelling of 'pending')
exhaustiveByDesign.workflow-api: WorkflowRunSnapshot.status: as TerminalWorkflowRun.status: the discriminant a reader switches on to reach a run's output or error
exhaustiveByDesign.workflow-api: WorkflowRunStatus — closed: the engine's five run states, the discriminant of WorkflowRunSnapshot; isTerminal/TERMINAL_WORKFLOW_STATUSES are total over it
